mapper.select: /* AppReq07Mapper.selectNextReqId */ SELECT CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d'), FNC_CMM_SEQ_NEXTVAL(#{cmpnyCd}, 'ATTD_REQ_ID')) FROM DUAL

/* AppReq07Mapper.selectSchedOptions */ SELECT S.SCH_CD AS schCd , S.SCH_NO AS schNo , S.BASE_YN AS baseYn , S.FST_SCH_STR_TIME AS fstStrTime , S.FST_SCH_END_TIME AS fstEndTime , S.SEC_SCH_STR_TIME AS secStrTime , S.SEC_SCH_END_TIME AS secEndTime FROM TB_SCH_MGMT S WHERE S.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND S.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND S.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY S.BASE_YN DESC, S.SCH_NO ASC
